title: Private Sunset Sail in Key West Florida
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a private Sunset Sail on a Classic 60 ft Schooner Serenity and get a front-row seat with just your family and friends to watch Key West's Famous sunsets. View Dolphins, Turtles, and all kinds of Marine Life.
Take the helm, learn how to raise and trim the sails, or just sit back and relax.

Enjoy a private sunset cruise off the coast of Key West See the sites of Key West from the water Snacks and beverages included Fun for an entire group or family Private guides for a more personalized experience.

Enjoy a private sunset sail off the coast of Key West and see the sights of Key West. Bring your favorite alcoholic beverages to enjoy while watching the sunset. Knowledgeable Captains to explain the art of sailing.
